name: InVariant
description: Infrastructure intelligence platform. Live-traffic stack fingerprinting, a call graph engine (9 node types, 10 edge types, 8 analyses), a Rust CLI, and the open-source clipy. 30 founder conversations, validated with 12 founders.

name: CatalystIQ
description: B2B SaaS I built directly with client companies, Dec 2023 to Apr 2024. Across everything we shipped, 250+ businesses used it.

phases.name: Phase 1: Services
phases.description: Web apps and product design for clients. First revenue, first client relationships.

phases.name: Phase 2: AI freelance marketplace
phases.description: A freelance platform built around small, AI-assisted gigs. Applicants submitted a piece of the actual work instead of a proposal.

phases.name: Phase 3: Inventory for quick commerce
phases.description: Inventory software used by 30–40 quick-commerce companies, plus a logistics optimizer aimed at cutting carbon. We dropped the optimizer when it didn't find market fit in India.

phases.name: Phase 4: DeLogi
phases.description: QR-based provenance for imported goods: every scan along the supply chain adds to the product's audit trail. Shut down because the market wasn't ready.

phases.name: Phase 5: CatalystIQ Hub
phases.description: An AI resume screener that 10+ B2B clients ran themselves to screen 4,000+ candidates. 65% shorter hiring cycles for clients, 18% conversion rate.

phases.name: Phase 6: Lead-gen automation
phases.description: Custom n8n workflows for client lead-generation pipelines.

name: Petner
description: Social platform for pet owners. My first startup, rebuilt four times over about a year.
